Field Name

customerIDString
Unique customer ID (CID) assigned by CrowdStrike
eventCreationTime
Time when the activity related to the detection began, in Unix epoch time
eventType
XdrDetectionSummaryEvent
offset
Starts at offset=0. Each new event (AuthActivityAuditEvent, DetectionSummaryEvent, UserActivityAuditEvent) increases the offset
counter by one. When reconnecting to the Falcon Streaming API, you can specify the offset value to tell the API the starting point
where you want to receive the events. If omitted, the API returns all previous detection summary or authentication events starting with
offset=0.
